Handle Plot Title and Export Naming

Source: R/help_plot.R
dot-handle_plot_title_and_export.Rd

Generates a formatted plot title and an export-friendly filename based on the provided parameters. The function adjusts titles dynamically based on various conditions, such as macro mode, variable duplication, title formatting options, and unit inclusion.

Usage

.handle_plot_title_and_export(
  var_name = NULL,
  sep_value = NULL,
  x_value = NULL,
  plot_type = NULL,
  is_macro_mode = FALSE,
  split_by = NULL,
  x_axis_from = NULL,
  variable_col = NULL,
  unit_name = NULL,
  style_config = NULL,
  data = NULL
)

Arguments

var_name

Character or NULL. The name of the variable being plotted.

sep_value

Character or NULL. Separator value to combine with var_name if applicable.

x_value

Character or NULL. X-axis value for additional context.

plot_type

Character or NULL. The type of plot, one of "comparison", "detail", "stack", or "unstack".

is_macro_mode

Logical. If TRUE, uses a simplified macro-style title.

split_by

Character or NULL. Column used for splitting data; checked for duplication with variable_col.

x_axis_from

Character or NULL. Source column for the X-axis.

variable_col

Character or NULL. Column representing the variable in the dataset.

unit_name

Character or NULL. Unit name to be appended to the title if applicable.

style_config

List or NULL. Formatting options for the title, containing:

  • title_format: List specifying format type ("prefix", "suffix", "full", or "dynamic").

  • add_unit_to_title: Logical indicating whether to append the unit name.

data

Data frame or NULL. Used for extracting values in dynamic title generation.

Value

A named list containing:

  • title: The final formatted plot title.

  • export_name: A cleaned, export-friendly version of the title.

See also

comparison_plot, detail_plot, stack_plot
